resolution.note: backlog triage 2026-11-07: Recorded date on notes folds into memory validity

title: Require a recorded date and source on every memory note
body: Outcome: every live memory note carries one `Recorded: YYYY-MM-DD via <session|commit|ADR Dnn>` line, and memory-refs reports a note without it as NO-PROVENANCE, so a reader can rank two contradicting notes by date and source (the per-line date and source tag Grok Bot injects). Extends t-j8hc9v4 (path to primary evidence). Proof: a fixture note without the line yields a NO-PROVENANCE finding; a note with it is clean.
